scenario: String ordering is lexicographic by codepoint per LSTR.3.2. A `<` comparison between two String slots of two patterns, `a.name < b.name`, compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: no ordering is evaluated. Codepoint ordering at runtime is the logical/LSTR.3.2_* vectors'.
rules_ds:
schema Tag scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    name: String mutable

rule trig:
    Tag a
    Tag b where a.name < b.name
->
    log info "ordered"
